name: Mist Orb body
notes: How the Mist Orb looks on the ground (a purple orb with a misty swirl) and the box the player touches to pick it up. Its shadow sits on the origin. Not solid and only touches the player: monsters walk over it and never take it. Shared by the classic run's floor item (item_mist_orb) and the waves mode's drop (item_waves_mist_orb).
